professionalSummary.text: Four years as Production Planner at a carton packaging plant with six converting lines, building weekly schedules from order books and line capacities under the plant's scheduling procedure.
professionalSummary.witness: Production planner at a carton packaging plant with six converting lines for four years, building each week's line schedule from the order book and the capacities of the six lines under the plant's scheduling procedure.

experienceHighlights.text: Resolved schedule conflicts with three shift managers in daily meetings, documented in conflict logs with adherence tracking; maintained schedule adherence above plant target in 15 of 16 quarters.
experienceHighlights.witness: Resolved the schedule conflicts raised by the three shift managers in the daily schedule meeting, with the conflict log recording each challenge, the resolution and the schedule adherence afterwards; adherence stayed above the plant target in fifteen of the sixteen quarters.

experienceHighlights.text: Maintained material call-off alignment with the schedule through weekly reviews with the materials buyer.
experienceHighlights.witness: Kept the material call-offs aligned with the schedule with the materials buyer through the weekly call-off review.

experienceHighlights.text: Reported weekly schedule adherence to plant manager, documenting responsibility boundaries for schedule changes.
experienceHighlights.witness: Reported schedule adherence to the plant manager each week, recording in the report which schedule changes were mine and which were the plant manager's decisions.

experienceHighlights.text: Documented open items and hand-over conditions for the next planning week in weekly reports.
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote the open items list and the hand-over conditions for the next planning week at each weekly report.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Weekly production schedule, conflict log with adherence figures, call-off review record, and adherence report with planning system references as verification trail.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: one weekly production schedule, one month's conflict log with the adherence figures, one call-off review record and one weekly adherence report, with the planning system references as a verification trail.

skills.text: Production scheduling, conflict resolution, material call-off coordination, schedule reporting, documentation.
skills.witness: Production planner at a carton packaging plant with six converting lines for four years, building each week's line schedule from the order book and the capacities of the six lines under the plant's scheduling procedure.
